messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 – firm long-term commitment for your capacity planning
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quote. Our orders with you for part:340010 rose from EUR 28.94 (po:4500010364-10) to EUR 29.89 (po:4500010407-10) between 2023-12-27 and 2024-01-05. That rise is already in our price. Our should-cost estimate for part:340010 is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010), below your price. The forecast for part:340010 increased by 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

Your letter says you prioritise firm, long-term commitments. The attached term sheets give you exactly that: our full annual volume, binding over 24 or 36 months. This gives you a secure base for planning your capacity. Which is the earliest lead time you can confirm?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 – firm long-term commitment for your capacity planning
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Your should-cost estimate does not reflect the specialized nature of our manufacturing process. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. 

We have verified your volume forecast and adjusted our offer to €31.50 for the 36-month term. Given our current capacity utilisation, 56 days is the earliest lead time we can confirm for this volume. Our Angebot comprises a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 - updated term sheets, full volume over 36 months
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for checking our data. To answer your question on volume: we commit 23400 pcs per year, binding over 36 months, or over 24 months in the alternative sheet. That is the firm, long-term commitment your letter of 18 September asks for, and it gives you a fixed share of your capacity to plan.

We have moved our price in all three attached sheets. The third sheet accepts your 56-day lead time. Could you also confirm 42 days from a later delivery month, once the backlog eases?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 - updated term sheets, full volume over 36 months
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your revised term sheets and your commitment to the 23400 pcs volume over 36 months. 

We build on your third term sheet and adjust our price to €31.40 per unit. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. 

Our Angebot comprises a price of €31.40 per unit, a Lieferzeit of 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
